headline: Nvidia names Colette Kress interim CEO in a $115.8B quarter; $130B outlook assumes no China compute

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: It's five to four UTC on Wednesday, November eighteenth, and this is ARA AI News. Nvidia named an interim chief executive in a record quarter, and wrote China data-center compute down to zero in the outlook.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Colette Kress, already the chief financial officer, is named interim chief executive in the fiscal twenty twenty-seven third-quarter eight-K. This is the first Nvidia filing that confirms Jensen Huang is out.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: Podcasts have treated Huang as gone for days, with reports that Alice Wang helped move seven point five billion dollars of processors and smuggle two hundred forty thousand banned H one hundred and H two hundred chips to China.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: None of those smuggling figures are in this eight-K, which names an interim chief executive and stops there. There is still no permanent successor.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: The print itself is a record. Third-quarter revenue was one hundred fifteen point eight billion dollars, up one hundred three percent from a year ago.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Data center was one hundred seven point six billion dollars, up one hundred ten percent from a year ago and twenty-one percent from the second quarter. Edge computing added eight point two billion, up forty-two percent from last year.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to one hundred thirty billion dollars, plus or minus three percent, and Nvidia is not assuming any data-center compute revenue from China.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Singapore had been called twenty-two percent of Nvidia revenue before Megaspeed was blacklisted, and that slice then vanished. The guide now bakes in zero China compute, not a rebound.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: On the release, Kress said Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, the roadmap is on track, and the ambition has never been greater. The eight-K does not give a shipment number for Rubin.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Put together, the capex boom is not cooling at the chip vendor. A hundred-and-thirty-billion-dollar fourth quarter with China compute at zero means demand outside China is carrying an even larger build.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: The rest of the live board did not move on this filing. The picture change is Nvidia, and only Nvidia.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Watch the conference-call transcript when it lands, whether Nvidia names a permanent chief executive, and whether China data-center compute stays at zero in the next outlook.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: That's ARA AI News. We'll be back when the picture changes.
